sources.citation: ELAR catalogue search 'Albarradas'; archive.org advancedsearch 'Albarradas zapotec'; Crossref / Zenodo / DOAJ / CIESAS-repository queries 'Albarradas'; local AILLA and OLAC dumps
sources.note: No linguistic item on Santa Catarina Albarradas Zapotec found in any of these (hits are Santo Domingo Albarradas SIL items, mezcal/agave theses, Ecuadorian 'albarradas' ponds, herpetology).

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid record sant1448 (JSON) and SIL-Mexico website (familia zapoteca index; publicaciones por idioma; zapoteco-zas page)
sources.note: Glottolog: 0 descriptive refs, MED 'wordlist_or_less' (Smith Stark 1994). SIL-Mexico: no page and no publications for ztn; the zas page states that Santa Catarina Albarradas speaks 'otra variante'.

sources.citation: Beam de Azcona, Rosemary. 2016. Zapotecan languages. Oxford Research Encyclopedia of Linguistics (on-disk text in sibling dir asun1236); also Beam de Azcona 2018/2019 Southern Zapotec classification papers and Egland 1978 Sondeos de inteligibilidad (on file, sanv1242/xada1235)
sources.note: No mention of Albarradas at all (grep = 0). Only the family-level remark that Zapotec shifted from Otomanguean final stress to stem-initial (usually penultimate) stress; not a statement about ztn.

sources.citation: Lewis, M. Paul, Gary F. Simons & Charles D. Fennig (eds.). 2016. Ethnologue: Languages of the World, 19th ed. Entry 'Zapotec, Santa Catarina Albarradas [ztn]'. Dallas: SIL International. (Wayback capture 2016-03-05)
sources.note: Nothing. Gives population (1,000, 1990), location (Santa Catarina Albarradas a.k.a. San Antonio Albarradas), '80% intelligibility of Santo Domingo Albarradas [zas]; Santo Domingo 52% of Santa Catarina. Differences in phonology and grammar.' No typology line; no grammar, dictionary or scripture listed under language development.

sources.citation: INALI. 2008 [print 2013]. Catalogo de las lenguas indigenas nacionales: variantes linguisticas de Mexico con sus autodenominaciones y referencias geoestadisticas, p. 191, variante <zapoteco de Valles, del noreste>.
sources.note: Nothing (locality catalog). Establishes identity: INALI lumps Santa Catarina Albarradas (mun. Villa Diaz Ordaz) with Santo Domingo / Santa Maria / San Miguel / San Lorenzo Albarradas as one variante 'zapoteco de Valles, del noreste' (dichsah / didxaza).

sources.citation: Kreikebaum, Wolfram. 1987. Fronting and related features in Santo Domingo Albarradas Zapotec. SIL-Mexico Workpapers 9: 33-71. (archive.org Rosetta extracts rosettaproject_zas_phon-1 / _detail-1; full scan in sibling dir sant1450)
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: open copy online
sources.note: Describes Santo Domingo Albarradas Zapotec (zas, sant1450), NOT ztn; p. 33 says only 'The speech of Santa Catarina Albarradas is somewhat different.' For zas: 'Syllables are either stressed or unstressed. There are three tonemes... In unstressed syllables there is neutralization of the rising and falling tones to a phonetic high pitch.' No stress-placement rule, and nothing on Santa Catarina.
